fixed_comparison.rows: intersection of valid primitive rows in factorized raw, legacy raw, exact DINO and exact SAM caches
fixed_comparison.sampling: all common valid rows when memory permits, otherwise the first 16384 rows after ascending global-row order
fixed_comparison.legacy_projection: official frozen adaptor applied to legacy normalized raw MPR
fixed_comparison.factorized_projection: same official frozen adaptor applied to factorized canonical_feature
metrics: input canonical norm mean median p05 p95
cosine to exact capability target mean and p05
centered row-variation RMS relative to exact capability target
factorized cache reconstruction and scalar-schema invariants

decision: Only a passing label-free source gate may proceed to factorized field training. A failing gate is diagnosed without opening benchmark target masks or text-query metrics.
